verdict.rationale: Cookieless tracking is a fair question for a product analytics tool, but the evidence pack never documents a cookieless mode, cookie-free persistence, or guidance on avoiding consent banners. The GDPR deletion APIs, EU data residency and server-side Import Events API are adjacent privacy and ingestion features, not a documented cookieless tracking capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
